# A-pillar light mounting and adjustment

## Summary

[Partial] Mount a bracket to an A-pillar using fender washers and secure it with a bottom nut. [t1037]

## Procedure

> **[Partial]** Needs more work: the verifier could confirm only part of this procedure (the steps marked [Partial], or whether the list is complete). Steps or precautions may be wrong or missing; read the source thread before relying on it. Later runs fill it in as more sources are found.

1. Mount the bracket to the A-pillar or door area using fender washers on the inside to disperse weight.
2. Secure a 5/8-inch nut at the bottom of the mount assembly.

_Procedure reported by [t1037]._
